Away Day Bonus

In the NPFL, home teams win. Everybody knows it — the pitches, the travel, the nine hours on a bus, the crowd. So backing an away player is the bravest thing you can do in this game, and we pay you for it.
The Three — and why it\'s not a secret
Three points to the best player in each match, two to the next, one to the next. The difference between us and everybody else is that we publish the reason.
You cannot buy points. Not a chip, not a transfer, not a multiplier. The day money buys points, the table starts lying.
